get.description:
Trials named by ID, then full-text search merged across search providers, within the
filter.

Every term with a letter and a digit, such as ``NCT04437511`` or ``nct04437511``, finds
the trial with that ID (``id_match`` is ``exact``), so a pasted list of IDs finds each
one. A single term of 7 or more characters also finds the trials whose ID starts with it
(``prefix``), for finding a trial as its ID is typed. Each hit has a snippet of the text
it matched. ``names`` adds conditions, interventions and sponsors whose names match, for
jumping to a filter.

get.description: The AI engine's settings: the model server, the model and the annotation labels.

patch.description:
Change the AI settings in ``tri-al.toml``. They apply at once.

Everything is checked before anything is written; ``labels`` replaces every label.

post.description:
The models a server offers: the saved one, or one being tried before it's saved.

A POST, though it changes nothing, because it makes this server reach the address the
request names: the browser protections then keep other websites from making it do so.

Mark the terms of each annotation label in one of the trial's texts, as it runs.

Nothing is stored: a text seen before with the same model and labels comes back at once
from memory.

get.description:
Terms whose trials read most like the term's: the nearest average trial vectors,
across the whole registry (there's no filter). The first request after a new data
version builds every term's average, which takes a few seconds.

Trials within the filter that the fields find, a page at a time.

Text fields search the full-text index, each in its own part of a trial; inclusion,
exclusion, primary and secondary outcomes are then checked in the text of the newest
candidates (`sections` says how many). Each hit says where its words are (`snippets`)
and, with a place, its nearest site.
